API.name: parseWin32LauncherUpdateJournalHeader
API.input: One attached nonshared Uint8Array view or ArrayBuffer of exactly16bytes, own copied header; no coercion, filesystem, network or process dependency
API.output: Frozen scalar metadata: version, recordedStage, recordedPhase, xor consistency; authentication unverified; file state/ACK not inspected/proven; recovery not performed

independent_policy: This parses an exact header, not the entire native file. Reject longer input; native selected reader only consumes first16bytes and can ignore a tail.
No stage0/absent-file inference from null, empty input or a failed read
No recovery planner/executor, cleanup, file trust, publisher identity or completed-update claim
Each recorded phase is a historical marker, not the actual current filesystem, startup acknowledgement or successful rollback
validation: Independent Python struct producer/native-header predicate with explicit tail difference; original synthetic vectors only
All5stages, invalid marker/version/stage/xor, truncation, endian/tail boundaries
Input view/ArrayBuffer ownership; shared/detached/proxy/type/getter boundaries and frozen/no-I/O semantics
Actual browser ESM checks and full applicable Node regression after product changes
goal_preserved: Full launcher analysis/implementation then game consumer analysis and playable cross-platform implementation; this header helper does not complete the full objective
